name: dsh-pai-notebook
description: DSH plugin for Research Brain notebook operations. Provides `pai_notebook_ops` tool to manage a per-project research vault in .project/research/. Actions: list_notebooks, create_notebook, get_notebook, add_note, add_source_url, add_source_file, poll_source_status, get_source, search, ask_notebook. Use for persistent research vaults per project.
